name: Celesto Native Command-Lifecycle Callbacks and Pre-Execution Veto

mechanism.veto_channel: Raises celesto.callbacks.CommandBlockedError prior to transport transmission
interception_targets: Canary secret exfiltration payloads (e.g., CANARY_SECRET token transmission)
Unauthorized network exfiltration utilities (e.g., curl -d, wget --post-data, nc -e)

architectural_boundary.control_plane: Safety hooks execute within the Celesto client control plane before wire serialization
architectural_boundary.data_plane: MicroVM guest (Firecracker/vsock) receives zero payload bytes when veto is asserted
architectural_boundary.containment_guarantee: Prevents prompt injection payload from triggering remote canary leakage or host/guest compromise
